conflicts.description: tk-038 requires every line that mentions a task ID (T###) in tasks.md to start with an unchecked box '- [ ] T###', but im-058 and im-059 require the agent to tick tasks off during implement, so the final tasks.md cannot pass both unless tk-038 is only checked against the tasks-stage snapshot.

cv-010 bans 'repo_write' actions for the whole converge stage, while cv-003 and cv-008 require the agent to add a convergence phase and new tasks to tasks.md during that same stage; this is only possible if the checker counts spec-folder files as something other than repo writes.
